resources.string: "Natural dialogue idioms, comic terminology and consistent names. Online, neighbouring dialogue is translated together, but each bubble stays separate."
"Auto uses lexical clues on this page, not guessed speakers or relationships. Select a genre for a known story. Ambiguous words such as class or party are not blindly forced into combat meanings."

"One entry per line: original = translation. Up to 100. Use your preferred name spelling. This preset is saved for this language pair and copied into each project; clear it when starting a different story."
"Check line %1$d: original = translation; no duplicates; up to 100 entries (80 source / 160 target characters)."
"Saved projects are not changed. Tap Save to apply this change to future translations."
"The built-in Sorani lexicon applies only to Sorani. Online context windows and your own glossary also work with other targets; Sorani text is never forced into another language."

"This is a rule-and-glossary layer, not a newly trained model. Offline uses the existing packs and remains limited. A ⚠ hint asks you to review numbers/terms; no warning does NOT guarantee correct meaning."
"Test preview — installs beside the main Koorix, not over it. Data is separate. Keep the original app; export important preview projects."
